Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

## 10. T.A. on Transfer  
[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part-II]  
- (a) Transfer means the movement of an employee from one headquarter station in which he is employed to another such station, either to take up the duties of a new post, or in consequence of a change of his headquarters. - SR 2 (18).
- the transfer is in the public interest
- (b) Admissibility.Admissible only if and not at one's own request.
